thread:
ana: Heads-up — Legal asked for a temporary analytics role so Support can run DSAR extraction queries without full PII access. Need RBAC + audit plan. Tagging @sam @vikram.
sam: What are the absolute minimum perms? Prefer query-only on masked datasets, no decrypt.
vikram: We can create role `analytics_dsar_reader` that gets SELECT on `analytics_view_masked` and read-only S3 on `s3://redwood-analytics/masked/`. No KMS decrypt. Add row-level filters to redact email/ssn columns at the view layer.
nana: Legal needs ability to attach the DSAR ticket id to logs and a proof artifact of what was returned. Audit entries need fields: dsar_id, query_hash, masking_version.
lisa: Do we have an existing audit schema to accommodate that? Current access logs don't include dsar_id.
sam: We'll add a small logging middleware in the query service to emit structured JSON to Splunk. Example payload inline: ```{"dsar_id":"SR-1234","user":"svc_analytics","query_hash":"sha256:...","masking_version":"v2","proof_blob_id":"pb-0001"}```
vikram: Confirming KMS stance: the analytics role gets ZERO decrypt permissions. Any need for plaintext must follow breakglass flow with two approvers (security + legal) and auto-expire creds after 1h. All breakglass actions get a keystore_request_id.
nana: Breakglass details: two approvers required, approval via PagerDuty/Slack flow, creds auto-revoke, and full session recording + proof blob stored.
sam: Implementation plan: 1) Terraform role & policy; 2) logging middleware + Splunk schema; 3) canary/e2e harness to validate no PII leakage; 4) update runbook and docs.
lisa: I'll own the Splunk schema. Request: can we add `masking_version` and `proof_blob_id` to `redwood_access` index? Also Product asked for 365d retention for DSAR proof logs; Security prefers 90d. We need a retention-exception decision.
vikram: Proposal: keep standard access logs at 90d. Full proof blobs retained 365d but encrypted in a restricted bucket with a separate KMS key only accessible to E-Discovery/legal roles. That limits blast radius.
sam: How do we avoid storing verbatim PII in S3 proof blobs? Suggest storing: encrypted payload + redaction map (fields removed) + CRC and query_hash. Proof blob should be encrypted with legal KMS key. Audit entry only references `proof_blob_id` and non-sensitive metadata.
lisa: Agreed. I'll add SIEM detection rule to alert on any `s3:GetObject` for `proof_blob_*` outside business hours and any direct KMS decrypt attempts.
privacy-bot: Reminder: update privacy-runbook.md and raise ticket PRIV-4567 for retention-exception approval.
nana: I'll open the infra PR with Terraform plan and include the canary test. ETA: EOD tomorrow. @sam can you draft runbook changes?
sam: :thumbsup: Will draft runbook and add an automated negative test that attempts to access raw PII and must fail.
vikram: Draft IAM policy snippet to start discussion:
```
resource "aws_iam_role" "analytics_dsar_reader" {
  name = "analytics_dsar_reader"
  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({/* OIDC trust for svc account */})
}
resource "aws_iam_policy" "analytics_dsar_policy" {
  name = "analytics_dsar_policy"
  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17",
    Statement = [
      {
        Effect = "Allow",
        Action = ["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],
        Resource = ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-analytics/masked/*"]
      }
    ]
  })
}
```
lisa: Also add a SIEM rule: alert if `analytics_dsar_reader` performs any request that includes columns outside the masked view or any `GetObject` on unmasked prefixes.
nana: Thanks all — I'll CC Legal on the PR and flag the retention-exception compromise (90d logs, 365d encrypted proof blobs) for approval. Closing loop here after PR lands.
